transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because... well, I know the people at my apartment building are watching me. They keep track of my comings and goings, and I know they're slipping notes about me to the office. Everybody keeps telling me it's just regular notices on the doors, but I know what's really going on.
How long have you noticed that the people in your building have been watching you?
Well, I'd say it's been about a year and a month now. That's when I first started noticing them keeping track of me and slipping things to the office.
Have you heard any voices or sounds when there is no one around to explain them?
No, I haven't heard anything like that. I mean, I hear the regular noises in the building, but no voices or anything when I'm by myself. It's just the watching and the notes that I told you about.

Yeah, I have. Um... most mornings, I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling. It's just... it's like the day already went bad before I even get my feet on the floor.
How long have you been experiencing that heavy, hollow feeling?
Well, I'd say it's been going on for about a year and two months now. That heavy, no-point feeling... and just pulling away from things. Yeah, it's been about that long.
During this past year, was there ever a period of two weeks or more where your mood felt completely normal, but you still believed the people were watching you?

Yeah, there was. There was a spell of several weeks where I was actually eating a bit better, and... well, I wasn't waking up feeling quite so hopeless. But even then, I still knew the neighbors were watching my door and reporting on me. That part never stopped.
Have you ever had periods of several days or more where you felt unusually energized, wired, or full of energy, and needed much less sleep than usual?
No, I haven't. I don't... I don't ever really feel wired or full of energy like that. Honestly, it's usually just the exact opposite. I mostly just feel pretty drained all the time.
